serverInfo.name: hibp-mcp-server
serverInfo.title: Have I Been Pwned MCP
serverInfo.description: Use public breach and data-class tools and resources without authentication. Account, paste, domain, subscription, domain-verification, stealer-log, and breached-account range tools require an OAuth bearer token linked to an active HIBP API subscription; plan features control access to k-anonymity and stealer-log results. Pwned Passwords range search is public, while breached-account range search is authenticated and requires local hash-suffix matching.
